states.name: Alabama

The rule sets no channel or content for the public notice; ADEM itself posts every report on a public map and layer.

citations.threshold: notifiable SSO: reaches a surface water of the State or may imminently and substantially endanger human health (r. 335-6-6-.02(hh))

states.name: California

law.summary: Sewer operators must tell the local health officer immediately (HSC 5411.5) and Cal OES within 2 hours for 1,000 gallons or more, and file a draft spill report in CIWQS within 3 business days. The public duty falls on county health officers, who must immediately post and close ocean beaches after a known sewage release and keep a closure hotline (HSC 115885, AB 411 regulations). CSO permits (San Francisco, Sacramento) carry their own notification plans.

states.name: Georgia

law.summary: A publicly owned treatment works that spills raw sewage to state waters must tell television, radio and print media within 24 hours, tell the local health department immediately, and immediately post signs at the spill and at public access points downstream for at least seven days; a major spill (over 10,000 gallons) also needs a county legal-organ notice within 7 days and notice to downstream water suppliers within 24 hours. EPD posts a daily 30-day list.

The report shall include at a minimum the following: 1. Date of the spill or major spill; 2. Location and cause of spill or major spill; 3. Estimated volume discharged and name of receiving waters; 4. Corrective action taken
citations.threshold: any spill of raw sewage to waters of the State

citations.title: Emergency Actions: signs
citations.quote: The owner of a POTW responsible for a spill or a major spill shall immediately post a notice as close as possible to where the spill or major spill occurred and where the spill or major spill entered State waters. ... These notices shall remain in place for a minimum of seven days after the spill or major spill has ceased.
